# myClover

> myClover (www.myclover.com) is a Thai creative house by Teem: guides, recipes, learning experiences and affiliate showcases for products we have chosen and tried. Pages are written in Thai unless noted.

## Mediral five-piece skincare set (affiliate showcase)

- [Mediral ชุดดูแลผิว 5 ชิ้น](https://www.myclover.com/mediral/): the routine in order, remembered as "เริ่มจากขาว ค่อยไปเขียว" — 01 cleansing mousse, 02 serum for acne-prone skin, 03 serum for dull-looking skin, 04 sunscreen serum, 05 pressed powder (optional makeup). Use only the pieces your skin needs; follow each product label.
- [01 มูสโฟมล้างหน้า](https://www.myclover.com/mediral/cl/)
- [02 เซรั่มผิวเป็นสิวง่าย](https://www.myclover.com/mediral/ac/)
- [03 เซรั่มผิวดูหมอง](https://www.myclover.com/mediral/br/)
- [04 เซรั่มกันแดด](https://www.myclover.com/mediral/su/)
- [05 แป้งพัฟ](https://www.myclover.com/mediral/po/)

Product roles and ingredient names come from Mediral brand material, not full label lists; ingredient pictures are illustrations. myClover is an affiliate partner, not the brand's official site. Orders are arranged through myClover on LINE: https://lin.ee/rlSlhzT
